summary: Micromem Technologies Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the closing of a non-brokered private placement. The company raised C$235,000 by issuing 9,400,000 units at C$0.025 per unit, each consisting of one common share and one warrant exercisable at C$0.05 per share for two years. No insiders participated; all subscribers are arm's-length. Proceeds will be used for working capital. The securities are subject to a four-month hold period and were not registered under the U.S. Securities Act. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation. No additional structural or strategic implications are present.
